item.title: Fearing GOP upset, top California Democrat urges lagging candidates for governor to drop out of race

item.title: Executed at Fran's Market: Inside the case that led to Clarence Ray Allen's death sentence
item.description: Three young employees were executed inside Fran's Market in Fresno in a calculated attack later traced to orders from convicted murderer Clarence Ray Allen. The case, preserved through original news footage, culminated decades later with Allen's trial, conviction and execution.
